judged_text: addMembers never clears the usernames input and no failure handling exists on addMembers/removeMember promise chains, so the stated membership-management intent is only half-implemented. After a successful add, the typed usernames stay in the selector; clicking Add again re-adds the same users, and a failed PUT/DELETE (e.g. 422 on automatic groups) leaves the UI showing the stale member list with no error message.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `addMembers` intentionally does not clear the input (`// TODO: should clear the input` in `admin-group.js.es6`), and both `Group.addMembers` / `Group.removeMember` only refresh members on success (`.then(function() { self.findMembers(); })`) with no `.catch`/error UI. That is a real, diff-grounded UX/incompleteness concern. However it’s not a clearly verifiable defect: the template hides add/remove controls for `automatic` groups (`{{#unless automatic}}`), and re-clicking “Add” may be idempotent server-side (not provably duplicating). Lack of explicit error messaging/clearing is more an incomplete feature than a correctness break.
